Burn.description: A burn: a subtitle written into an episode's picture.

clipId.description: The clip it filed, once finished.

BurnedFrom.description: What a burned clip was burned from.

Deleted.description: The key of a member deleted, as its event carries it.

available.description: Whether its file is on disk.

burnedFrom.description: For a burned clip, what it was burned from.

granted.description: Whether the caller reads it by a grant alone (`docs/design.md`, 「Grants」).

EpisodeChange.description: An episode's change: the fields named; `season` and `number` null to clear, `titleId` against another title.

titleId.description: The title the episode moves under; a library's episode is refused.

oneOf.description: A filed output, or a burned one.

FiledByPath.description: A video filed by a path on the service's own host.

path.description: An absolute file the service reads, copied into its file root.

Grant.description: One account an episode is shared with.

grantor.description: The account that granted it; empty where the service token named none.

user.description: The account key, as the console's `Owner-Key` carries it.

JobState.description: Where a scan or a burn stands.

scannedAt.description: The end of its last finished scan.

NewGrants.description: The accounts to share an episode with.

name.description: Its own title's name; the show name most of its folder's files share, else the folder's, where none.

path.description: An absolute folder the service reads, outside its file root.

NewShare.description: A link to make: one of the two members.

Permission.description: What a grant opens (`docs/design.md`, 「Grants」): both permissions open the same reads.

oneOf.description: The permission a grant takes where none is given.

PlaylistChange.description: A playlist's change: its name, or its whole order.

at.description: The place the first goes, from 0; the end where none.

Position.description: A viewer's place in an episode.

done.description: Whether it counts as watched; it becomes true by itself at nine tenths of the duration.

seconds.description: The seconds watched to, 0 or more.

Progress.description: A viewer's progress through a playlist or a title.

next.description: The episode to watch next, or null.

nextSeconds.description: The seconds to start it from.

Realm.description: One of the two realms (`docs/design.md`, 「Two realms」).

oneOf.description: The organization's, read by every account.

Scan.description: One reading of a library's folder.

changedCount.description: Episodes read again, or found back on disk.

url.description: The share address; null where the settings name none.

ShareDeleted.description: The token of a link ended, as its event carries it.

ShareHead.description: What a share address reads as before it is opened (bmo-ui's `docs/console-bundles.md`, 「Share pages」).

SubtitleByPath.description: A subtitle added by a path on the service's own host.

libraryId.description: The library it was indexed from; null for a title made by hand.

TitleChange.description: A title's change: the fields named.

oneOf.description: A series, its episodes numbered by season and episode.

WireError.description: A failure, in the platform's shape.

bearer.description: The service token (naming its account with Owner-Key), or the console's credential with Owner-Key and Owner-Role; the console's reaches each operation as its x-console says.

info.description: The platform's store of videos: titles made of episodes, filed outputs kept in the service's file root and libraries of video files indexed in place, streamed as they are with HTTP ranges, with subtitles converted to WebVTT and burned in on request, playlists, each viewer's watch position, and share links. Titles, libraries and playlists stand in one of two realms, an account's own (mine) or the organization's. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys, times are epoch milliseconds, lists are pages of items and more, and every failure is the error shape with its status. The tool's entries, placed on the tool host, are stated under x-tools.
